510601.name: Toxic Bullet
510601.description:
Fires a toxic bullet from its back, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
Deals additional damage if the attack hits.

510602.name: Contaminated Projectile
510602.description:
Launches a barrage of projectiles, dealing damage to multiple Nikkes.
Deals significant sustained damage if the attack hits more than once.
Can be interrupted by destroying the Poison Chamber.

510604.name: Shock Wave
510604.description: Ultra smashes the ground, dealing massive damage to all Nikkes.

510605.name: Toxic Shells
510605.description:
Spews toxic shells from its mouth, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Deals significant sustained damage if the attack hits.

510606.name: Toxic Dust
510606.description:
Collects and shoots toxic dust, dealing massive damage to a single Nikke.
This attack can be interrupted by attacking the horns.

510608.name: Toxic Substance Spray
510608.description: Ejects a powerful toxic substance from its entire body. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals massive damage to all Nikkes.
